note: Addresses that must never create a funding edge. A wallet 'funded by' the Uniswap router is an artefact of how a swap settles, not a relationship with anyone. Entries here are excluded from edge construction entirely, and are also used as cut points when connected components are taken.
coverage_warning: This list is incomplete by construction - new routers and aggregators deploy constantly. It is a first pass, not the mechanism relied on: funding.py flags any address funding more than HIGH_DEGREE_FUNDER wallets and refuses it an edge whether or not it appears here. That empirical check is what actually protects the graph; this list only makes the common cases legible.
